cause: After 58 Builder model calls and 33 draft revisions, the next relay caused the local Lilies get_session endpoint to raise sqlite3.OperationalError: disk I/O error while reading the clients table. The platform received HTTP 502 from the exact daemon operation and durably failed the assignment as daemon_rejected. The database remained readable after shutdown and the volume retained 169 GiB free, so this is classified as a transient daemon storage-path failure pending the retained root-cause repair.
claim_boundary: Revision 17 did not reach an operational permission, real host request, customer artifact, host receipt, formal report, archive preflight, claim, or oracle run. It proves neither the revision-17 permission projection repair under a real oversized request nor customer workflow delivery and remains a failed customer attempt in the project denominator.
retained_fix_route: Identify and remove the generic concurrent SQLite access condition or add a bounded safe retry at the storage boundary without converting persistent or corrupt-database failures into success. Freeze a child revision only after focused concurrency and failure-preservation regressions pass.
